editorial:
Imagine living in a city where everyone is chasing a quick buck and the law barely matters. You get to follow Man Tsz-keung, a regular guy who is tired of being poor and decides to take a huge risk. He teams up with a flight attendant named Lok Ka-yuen to pull off a massive heist. It starts as a way to get ahead, but the money quickly turns him into someone obsessed with power. You will feel the tension as he goes head-to-head with a rich businessman who has way more resources than he does, making the whole thing feel like a dangerous game of cat and mouse.

The acting is top-notch and keeps you glued to your seat, though some of the middle parts drag a bit. The best part is seeing the two different police forces finally work together to bring the criminals down. If you love crime stories with high stakes, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head in a massive showdown between the police and the criminals. After a long chase, the joint police task force traps Man Tsz-keung in a final standoff. He realizes that his greed cost him everything, including his relationship with Ka-yuen. The movie ends with the police making the arrest, proving that no matter how much money you steal, you cannot outrun the law forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heist movies and police dramas.
